title: The Blue Clips
description: This small-format artwork presents an intimate, tight close-up focusing on a girl's face. The composition highlights a singular eye and her hair, adorned with four striking, vibrant blue hair clips. Adopting the candid, high-contrast aesthetic of a direct flash photograph, the piece feels like a frozen cinematic still. The harsh light isolates these details, elevating a small, everyday moment of vulnerability and personal style into a narrative fragment. It explores themes of youth, identity, and the quiet beauty found in close-up observations of intimacy.

images.alt: The blue clips, acrylic on canvas
